method: paired 2024-2025 redraft replay against competent need-aware market baselines

rules.snake_baseline: Need-aware ADP/market manager using the same roster constraints and no random handicap.
rules.auction_baseline: Need-aware generic-AAV manager with the same budget reserve logic; only the framework receives intrinsic/ceiling/scarcity max-bid adjustments.
rules.lineups: Pregame weekly projections choose starters; realized points score Weeks 1-14; no waivers.
rules.validation_threshold: Positive mean with 95% interval fully above zero.
rules.auction_limitation: League-specific historical-price calibration is not tested until actual league auction records are available.
